sections.content: You know reported speech from B1 Unit 25 (*estilo indirecto*): after a past reporting verb, the verb moves back one step. This lesson contrasts the two ways of telling what someone said: direct speech repeats the exact words, and indirect speech reports them with *que* and without quotation marks.

items.english: She said that she was tired.

items.spanish: El testigo dijo que no había visto nada.
items.english: The witness said that he had not seen anything.

sections.content: English can drop “that” (“She said she was tired”), but Spanish always keeps *que*: *Ella dijo que estaba cansada*.
